archetype.gesturalcombat.sword.desc: Quick arcs and precise finishers. Gestures reward momentum and clean lines.
archetype.gesturalcombat.axe.desc: Heavy, wide swings that trade speed for raw crowd-clearing force.
archetype.gesturalcombat.spear.desc: Reach and piercing lunges. Every line you draw becomes a thrust.
archetype.gesturalcombat.shield.desc: A one-handed weapon and shield. Turn the shield into a weapon of its own.
archetype.gesturalcombat.bow.desc: Charge the bow fully to awaken its elemental shots.
technique.gesturalcombat.sword_slash.des: A broad horizontal sweep that catches everything in front of you.
technique.gesturalcombat.sword_rising.de: An upward slash that lifts enemies off their feet.
technique.gesturalcombat.sword_whirl.des: Two full spinning cuts that punish anyone standing close.
technique.gesturalcombat.sword_flurry.de: Four rapid strikes in a narrow arc, each one faster than the last.
technique.gesturalcombat.sword_execute.d: A single brutal downward cut with heavy knockback.
technique.gesturalcombat.sword_guard.des: Raise your blade and brace: Resistance III for one second. Long cooldown.
Lunge forward with a fast rising slash, then retreat. Minimal knockback.
technique.gesturalcombat.axe_cleave.desc: An overhead chop with a short, crushing arc.
technique.gesturalcombat.axe_wide.desc: A slow horizontal sweep that covers almost everything in front.
technique.gesturalcombat.axe_rend.desc: An upward tear that leaves a bleeding wound.
technique.gesturalcombat.axe_cyclone.des: Two spinning axe strikes around your body.
technique.gesturalcombat.axe_quake.desc: A zigzag charge that ends in a radial shockwave.
technique.gesturalcombat.spear_thrust.de: A piercing thrust that carries you forward.
technique.gesturalcombat.spear_sweep.des: A wide horizontal cut that keeps enemies at reach.
technique.gesturalcombat.spear_impale.de: Three narrow thrusts into the same line.
technique.gesturalcombat.spear_tempest.d: Three spinning spear strikes that clear a circle.
technique.gesturalcombat.spear_skyfall.d: A downward slam that launches enemies upward.
technique.gesturalcombat.shield_bash.des: Shove the shield forward, striking everything in a wide arc with heavy knockback.
technique.gesturalcombat.shield_guard.de: Hold the shield for two seconds. Attacks from the front are completely negated, but you cannot attack.
technique.gesturalcombat.shield_charge.d: Dash forward with the shield and stun everything struck for three seconds.
technique.gesturalcombat.shield_throw.de: Hurl the shield at up to three enemies, weakening and slowing them. The shield needs time to return.
technique.gesturalcombat.bow_fire.desc: Loose a burning arrow that leaves a short-lived patch of fire on impact.
